from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    gaps_by_row = []
    for r in range(h):
        gaps = []
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            color = grid[r][c - 1]
            if grid[r][c] == 0 and color != 0 and grid[r][c + 1] == color:
                gaps.append((c, color))
        gaps_by_row.append(gaps)
    for r, gaps in enumerate(gaps_by_row):
        for c, color in gaps:
            out[r][c] = color
            rr = r - 1
            while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = color
                rr -= 1
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
